title: Q-PARITY-7: Wake the executor from the tick without a person-minted token
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/wrangler.template.jsonc::GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN
**Status:** open

Quniverse parity (owner directive 2026-11-13: Ultrastable audits and remediates all failure modes and ships improvements with zero user intervention; every Quniverse automation feature is incorporated).

ultrastable-tick has only a DB binding, so executor.js github-actions provider is never available; GitHub's cron has fired 5 times in 1011 runs. EXEC-SPARK-1 (merge-triggered executor) and EXEC-SPARK-2 (tick files EXEC-SPARK-UNREACHABLE) are in place. Build the remaining route: a GitHub App installation token minted by an Actions run from its own built-in token cannot reach the Worker, so provision GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN onto the Worker from a repository workflow that holds the scoped secret, never printing it, and prove with a repository_dispatch run.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/wrangler.template.jsonc::GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN
